title: Entity relationship diagrams
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: Where is a FK stored in a one-to-many relationship?
Choose the model answer: What does PK stand for?
Choose the model answer: What is an associative entity?
Choose the model answer: A BST root20 has left10 and right30; insert 25. Describe comparisons and placement.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: ERDs model entities and relationship cardinalities before implementing tables.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: One-to-many relationships are typically represented with a foreign key on the many side.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Many-to-many relationships require an associative/junction table when translated into a relational schema, often with two foreign keys.
